summary: DoubleDown Interactive Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim consolidated financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026, prepared under IFRS. The filing includes balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow data but does not announce any special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is a routine periodic earnings report with no transactional or corporate action component.
